_notes: All balance values. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the loader. Paths in _placeholders are not from the docs and will be calibrated by simulation. Modifiers are logit units unless the key name says otherwise. Every check declares kind: twoSided (D-017), oneSided (D-019, side names the present side) or noCheck. Schema: docs/data-schema.md.

checkFormula._notes: minProbability/maxProbability clamp every check except the shot's goal probability and xG, which use checks.shot.minProbability/maxProbability (D-014, Q-009). referenceValue replaces the missing side in oneSided checks (D-019) and is the zero point of ...PerPoint modifiers.

faceoff._notes: Success = attacker-side centre wins the draw. Values: stats-and-checks.md, Tarkistukset.

pass._notes: Success = pass reaches the receiver. laneDefenderDistance is indexed by the nearest defender's node distance from the passing lane (0, 1, 2+). underPressure (condition, D-049): passer is under physical pressure (definitions M-7); placeholder derived from analysis (85 % -> about 70 % under pressure = about -0.9 logit). Not scaled by the team pressure state. interceptionShare (D-040): share of failed passes that are interceptions (lane defender gains the puck); the rest become a loose puck at the lane defender's node.

zoneEntryCarry._notes: Success = carrier enters the offensive zone with possession.

dumpIn._notes: No check (stats-and-checks.md). Play action dump (D-031): the puck goes to the target node and a loose-puck check follows there. If the target is within goalieReachNodes (Chebyshev) of the goal node, goaliePuckHandlingPerPoint (logit per goalie puckHandling point above checkFormula.referenceValue) favours the defending team in that loose-puck check. Time cost: time.secondsPerAction.dumpIn.

deke._notes: 1v1 deke, also the carry check of a skate action that neither leaves the defensive zone nor enters the offensive zone (D-032: every carry is a check). Success = carrier keeps the puck. defenderDistance is indexed by the nearest defender's node distance from the skating path (0, 1, 2+), same lane rule as pass.laneDefenderDistance. Energy applies via energy.checkModifierAtZero.

breakout._notes: Breakout from own zone. Success = puck leaves the defensive zone with possession. forecheckers = mean of the forechecking players' stats. Defensive system effect is a later modifier (Q-003).

shot._notes: Order: block -> onTargetShare -> goal check (Q-010). Success = goal. p0 = baseXg[xgZone] of the shooting node in the shooter's view. Shooter weights slide with distance (attackerByXgZone): slot accuracy 0.8, blue line power 0.7 from docs, others interpolated placeholders. behindNet (E-002) = wraparound / shot from behind the goal line, very low xG. Goal probability and xG are clamped to minProbability..maxProbability here, not checkFormula (D-014, Q-009). screenContested (Q-031, D-062) replaces screen when a defender is on the net-front node. missedOutOfPlayShare (D-063): share of missed shots that leave the rink (stoppage, faceoff); the rest stay loose at loosePuckSpots.missedShot.

block._notes: One-sided (D-019): H = checkFormula.referenceValue, D = defender side. Success = shot gets through (not blocked). distancePerNode: logit in the shooter's favour per node between shooter and blocker. Clamped with checkFormula bounds (block is a check). Blocker = defender nearest the shot lane (shooter node to goal node, goal node excluded) within maxLaneDistance nodes; no candidate = no block check. laneDistance (table by the blocker's lane distance) is logit in the shooter's favour. Definitions M-5 in data-schema.md (D-049).

rebound._notes: One-sided (D-019): H = checkFormula.referenceValue, D = goalie side. After a save. Success = rebound to the slot (attacker outcome). Otherwise the goalie controls it: controlledHoldShare of those are held (stoppage), the rest go to the corner.

loosePuck._notes: Three outcomes. noWinnerShare from analysis (22 %). The remaining share is split by the logistic check (p0 0.5 -> 39 / 22 / 39 for equal players, Q-007). Who reaches the puck: speed and system-mode instructions. Participants: each team's skater nearest the puck. distancePerNode x (defender distance - attacker distance). extraPlayer once for the team with more skaters within extraPlayerRadius nodes. Definitions M-6 in data-schema.md (D-049).

hit._notes: Success = hitter separates the opponent from the puck. Penalty risk from discipline (probability, not logit).

time._notes: Game seconds. Forward trios and defence pairs rotate separately (D-023): forwardShiftSeconds / defenceShiftSeconds are target shift lengths. secondsPerAction.systemStep: one system-mode step (team holds the puck without a play, D-036, or a loose puck with no winner is contested again).

energy._notes: Energy 0..1 (D-062, data-schema.md, Energia). On ice a skater loses drainPerSecondOnIce per game second and costPerAction per check he takes part in (every participant, loose-puck battlers included), both scaled by 1 - enduranceCostReductionPerPoint x (endurance - checkFormula.referenceValue). On the bench energy recovers exponentially: E <- 1 - (1 - E) x exp(-benchRecoveryRate x seconds). The goalie loses energy only from the opposing team pressure (pressure.energyDrainPerSecond). checkModifierAtZero = logit at energy 0 applied to every check, linear in between, per side as the mean of the side's participants.

positions._notes: Positions C, LW, RW, LD, RD (D-024). offSideCheckModifier (logit, negative) applies to every check a player takes part in while playing the opposite side of his primary position (LW<->RW, LD<->RD). Added to M when the player is on the attacker side, subtracted when on the defender side, so it always hurts his own side. Applied once per check side, even if several players on that side are off-side.

organization._notes: 0..1 per defending team, a scalar that the checks read; defender positions follow it with a delay (D-062, data-schema.md, Järjestäytyneisyys). On a turnover the losing team's value becomes min(O, 1 - dropOnTurnover[zone where the puck was lost, losing team view]) - dropPerCommittedPlayer x committed players; after a shot, rebound, block or dump the drop is multiplied by dropFactorOnShotOrDump. Recovers recoveryPerSecond x (1 + recoveryPerStatPoint x (S - checkFormula.referenceValue)) per game second, S = mean over the five skaters of recoveryWeights. organizedThreshold: rush ends and chance type stops being rush at or above it. Each check lists its own organization modifier (logit for the attacker at defender organization 0, linear).

pressure._notes: 0..1 per attacking team. underPressureNodes: a player is under pressure when an opposing skater is within this Chebyshev distance (definitions M-7, D-049); 0 = same node (D-056), calibrated later against the analysis (Q-032). Physical pressure, not the team pressure state.

familiarity._notes: Per team, per play and per match (mirror image = same play), counted when the play starts, interrupted and faceoff plays included (D-066). Penalty (logit against the attacker) = min(maxPenalty, penaltyPerRepeat x max(0, uses - freeUses)), uses including the current start. Applies to the play's passes, carries and blocks. The counter is multiplied by intermissionMultiplier at every intermission (D-066: halved).

chanceClasses._notes: xG thresholds for top / good / moderate chances (Q-004, question for the brother).

loosePuckSpots._notes: Where a loose puck ends up (D-044). Values are rule names from data-schema.md, Definitions, Irtokiekon paikat. A loose-puck contest (M-6) follows at the spot.
